name: Biocon Ltd.
business_summary: Bengaluru-based biopharma: biosimilars (Biocon Biologics, consolidated; insulins, bevacizumab, trastuzumab, adalimumab, ustekinumab, pertuzumab pipeline), generics/APIs and Syngene (CRDMO stake, not in the Nifty-200 universe per nodes list). TTM revenue Rs 17,414 cr (+6%), EBITDA Rs 3,532 cr (20%) but PAT only Rs 340 cr because of Rs 895 cr interest and high depreciation. Q2 FY27: total income Rs 4,423 cr, EBITDA Rs 865 cr, net profit Rs 41 cr (-51%); biosimilars margin fell to 22% on shipment timing; Generics returned to EBITDA profit in H1.

exposures.mechanism: Foreign-currency revenue ~70% of sales (biosimilars US/EU/ROW, generics): +3% USD/INR adds Rs 365 cr annual revenue and ~Rs 290 cr EBITDA after ~15% imported cost (EBITDA Rs 3.5k cr -> +8%); USD debt translation loss on unhedged portion partly offsets (non-cash); EV/MCap 1.24, persistence 0.4 -> +4; the pack's empirical sensitivity (+6.12, t=3.4) is the strongest of the batch, so weight set at +5.

evidence.note: screener.in financials retrieved 2026-11-05; weight is model-derived (see mechanism)

exposures.mechanism: Generics + biosimilar price erosion: generics ~20% of sales; +5pp erosion -> -1% group sales / OPM 20% = -5% EBITDA x persistence 0.5 x EV/MCap 1.24 -> -3.1; offset by launches -> -2.5.

evidence.note: Q2 FY27 total income Rs 4,423 cr, EBITDA Rs 865 cr, net profit Rs 41 cr (-51%); biosimilars margin 22% on shipment timing; Generics back to EBITDA profit in H1 (Biocon release, NDTV Profit, Multibagg)
